versions.content: Declaration of production errors If a BSW module reports diagnostic events to the module DEM (= Diagnostic Event Manager ,see [26]), its BswInternalBehavior shall contain for each kind of diagnostic event one Ser- viceDependency element in the role serviceDependency . This diagnostic event is further characterized by the element ServiceDependency . serviceNeeds which shall be an instance of meta-class DiagnosticEventNeeds . If the diagnostic event describes a production error, its DiagnosticEventNeeds . category attribute shall have one of the following values: • PRODUCTION_ERROR if it represents a production error. • EXTENDED_PRODUCTION_ERROR if it represents an extended production er- ror. Its DiagnosticEventNeeds . shortName shall be equal to the error symbol defined in the AUTOSAR SWS of the respective module if the production error is standardized.
